verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents SDKs in six languages, a REST API with an OpenAPI spec, and a hosted first-party MCP server, but nothing about an official command-line interface. These are adjacent developer surfaces, not a CLI, so they earn no credit. A billing platform could plausibly ship a CLI, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
